away.name: Jacob Fowler
away.news: Jakub Dobes had a breakout 2025-26 season, leading the Canadiens to an impressive playoff run, but his sluggish start to 2026-27 opened a door for Jacob Fowler. The 21-year-old Fowler saved 23 of 26 shots (.885 SV%) in his most recent game, a 4-3 overtime win over the Buffalo Sabres. He has a 2.16 GAA and .900 SV% in four games this season (3-1-0). The Canadiens enter Friday's contest as -161 road favourites against a Chicago Blackhawks team coming off a 4-0 shutout loss to the Dallas Stars.

home.name: Spencer Knight
home.news: The Blackhawks have played better since welcoming Connor Bedard into the lineup, going 2-1-0, but keeping the puck out of their net remains an issue. Knight has allowed three or more goals in six of seven games this season, including allowing four on 32 shots (.875 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 4-0 loss to the Dallas Stars. The 25-year-old American goalie has a 3.59 GAA and .888 SV% in seven games (3-4-0). The Blackhawks enter Friday's contest as +145 home underdogs against a Montreal Canadiens team with their own defensive struggles, allowing 15 goals in their last four games (2-1-1).

away.name: Andrei Vasilevskiy
away.news: With a 7-2-0 record, Tampa Bay leads the Eastern Conference in points percentage (.778) and hopes to carry their early-season success into Friday with Vasilevskiy tending the twine. The two-time Vezina Trophy winner hasn't had to be spectacular this season, but is coming off a strong performance, saving 32 of 34 shots (.941 SV%) in a 6-2 win over the Vegas Golden Knights. He has 2.46 GAA and .898 SV% in seven games (5-2-0). Tampa Bay enters the action as +110 road underdogs against a Colorado Avalanche team that is 2-3-1 in their last six games.

home.name: Mackenzie Blackwood
home.news: The Avalanche have lost two straight and hope to return to the win column on Friday, with Blackwood tending the twine against the Tampa Bay Lightning. Blackwood has been far from spectacular this season, but Head Coach Jared Bednar has leaned on him more than counterpart Scott Wedgewood. The 29-year-old Blackwood has a 2.90 GAA and .889 SV% in seven games (4-3-0). Colorado enters Friday's contest as -122 home favourites against a Tampa Bay Lightning team on a 7-1-0 run.
